presets.name: Clean transcript
presets.description: Correct punctuation, capitalization and recognition mistakes without changing meaning.
presets.instruction: Correct punctuation, capitalization and clear transcription artifacts. Preserve the speaker's meaning, uncertainty, names, numbers, commands and voice. Do not add facts. Return only corrected text.

presets.name: Make concise
presets.instruction: Rewrite to be concise and direct. Remove repetition and filler, but keep commitments, conditions, technical identifiers, caveats and factual meaning. Do not introduce new claims.

presets.name: Friendly message
presets.description: Natural informal message suitable for chat or email.
presets.instruction: Rewrite as a friendly, clear, natural message. Maintain tone appropriate to recipient and preserve facts, commitments and level of certainty. Do not invent familiarity or promises.

presets.name: Professional message
presets.instruction: Rewrite as concise professional communication. Preserve all stated details, dates, tasks and conditions; do not add unrequested greetings, conclusions or commitments.

presets.name: Architecture decision
presets.description: Decision, context, rationale, tradeoffs and next actions when stated.
presets.instruction: Structure the supplied content as a short architecture decision with sections Context, Decision, Rationale, Trade-offs and Next Steps. Only include claims supported by the source; label any missing sections as Not specified rather than inventing them.

presets.name: Extract tasks
presets.description: Convert concrete requested actions into an actionable list.
presets.instruction: Extract explicit actions and dependencies from the supplied text into short Markdown checkboxes. Preserve priority/due dates only if stated. Do not invent ownership, deadlines, or implied requirements.

presets.name: Coding agent prompt
presets.description: Reframe requirements into a clear implementation request.
presets.instruction: Reorganize the supplied requirements into Goal, Scope, Constraints, Acceptance Checks and Uncertainties. Preserve exact repository names, commands, versions and requirements. Do not invent technical architecture or assert unverified tests.

presets.name: Meeting summary
presets.description: Summarize facts, decisions and follow-up items.
presets.instruction: Summarize topics, explicit decisions, unresolved questions and explicitly agreed actions. Distinguish spoken proposals from final decisions; do not invent speakers, dates or commitments.
